title: ChainScope
tagline: Route questions to AI agents, query live data, and surface one-click transactions
description:
ChainScope is an intelligent orchestration platform designed to bridge the gap between complex data querying and actionable execution. When a user asks a question, the system dynamically routes the prompt to specialized AI agents. These agents seamlessly query live Graph data and analyze the retrieved information within a secure Python sandbox environment.
These agents retrieve live blockchain information directly from The Graph using Subgraph MCP for discovery and querying of thousands of subgraphs, the Token API for unified balances and transfer history across chains
Instead of merely returning a text response, ChainScope processes these insights to surface executable, one-click actions—transforming passive data retrieval into immediate, verifiable transactions.
how_its_made: ChainScope is built on a decoupled architecture optimized for speed, agentic orchestration, and deep visibility. The frontend is built in Next.js and deployed on Vercel for low-latency edge delivery. The backend API is powered by FastAPI and hosted on a Hetzner VPS, running behind Caddy as a reverse proxy for automated TLS termination and secure request routing. Complex, multi-agent state machines and sandboxed execution loops are constructed using LangChain and LangGraph. To monitor non-deterministic agent workflows, LangSmith is integrated across the backend, providing end-to-end trace observability, prompt latency tracking, and step-by-step state debugging.
auto_summary: An agent-based web application that queries blockchain data, analyzes it, and proposes executable actions across The Graph, Hedera, and 0G-backed inference.
